value: Civil Code of Georgia, rental contract provisions (Articles 531-569).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: If the tenant must provide security, it may not exceed three times one month's rent, and may be paid in equal monthly instalments over three months; interest at the statutory rate accrues on security paid in advance and is returned to the tenant with it after the tenancy; contrary agreements to the tenant's detriment are void (Art. 552).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: The notice period for terminating a rental contract is three months unless the circumstances or the parties' agreement provide otherwise (Art. 561); termination must be in writing (Art. 563).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: The landlord may terminate a tenancy agreement only for valid reasons: substantial breach by the tenant, the landlord needing the dwelling for self or close relatives, the tenant refusing market-rate increased rent offered by the landlord, or serious illegal or immoral acts against the landlord; for a furnished apartment the landlord may always terminate observing the notice period (Art. 562).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: The lessor may terminate before the term expires if the lessee has not paid rent for three months (Art. 558).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: The tenant of a dwelling may terminate before expiry by giving the landlord one month's notice and meeting the conditions in Art. 555.
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.

value: If the lessee continues to use the property after the term ends and the lessor does not object, the contract is deemed extended for an indefinite term (Art. 559(2)).
note: English translation on Matsne; the Georgian text prevails.
